what: 00693 item 1 (the global cache in the v2 daemon) needs a decision before cargo wires it: docs/v2/plan/lanes/fastcompile/global.md is a plan and nothing says where a daemon gets the cache endpoint and trust (an env var such as BLAZE_GLOBAL=<https url>, a [workspace.metadata.blaze] key, or the blaze config file), or whether blaze_global::Client becomes the blaze_cas Store Remote (the doc says so) or a client the daemon steps itself (serve/unit/script/global.rs Fetch assumes the daemon steps it). Proposal: the daemon reads one typed setting at start (endpoint + pinned publisher from sign::PINNED), owns one Client on the loop, routes its completions beside the store, and steps each crates.io build script run through script/global.rs Fetch before it runs; with no setting, no fetch (not a fallback: a cache that is not configured). Answer on 00693 and cargo wires it.
